name: Lijiang
tagline: Naxi old town under Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
summary: Lijiang's UNESCO old town is a maze of canals, stone bridges and wooden Naxi houses under the glacier-capped Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Ride the cable car toward the glacier, see the Black Dragon Pool reflection, stay in quieter Baisha and Shuhe villages, and hike the Tiger Leaping Gorge, one of the world's deepest.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are clear; July and August are rainy and busy with domestic tourists.
arrival: Flights from Kunming, Chengdu and Shanghai; high-speed trains from Kunming take about 3 hours.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; taxis and DiDi for villages; buses to Tiger Leaping Gorge.
cashTip: Mobile payment (Alipay, WeChat Pay) is everywhere and both accept foreign cards; carry some cash too. No tipping.
foodTip: Naxi baba flatbread, yak hot pot, black dragon pool fish and Yunnan mushrooms.
buyTip: Pu'er tea and Naxi Dongba crafts.
